gaps.explanation: p5 governmental funds statement prints one net row 'Transfers in (out)' per fund: General Fund 7,402; Sales Tax Fund (840,301); Pool Project Sales Tax Fund -; Other Governmental Funds 493,984; Total (338,915) = JSON transfers_out 338,915 (net). detail[] records the transfers gross per fund: General Fund 7,402 (p14), Sales Tax Fund (840,301) (p11), nonmajor (p13) Equipment Sinking Fund 411,000, Debt Service Fund 95,414, Capital Projects Fund (12,430) (411,000 + 95,414 - 12,430 = 493,984 = Other Governmental Funds column). Gross out 840,301 + 12,430 = 852,731 vs net 338,915; the difference 513,816 = gross transfers in 7,402 + 411,000 + 95,414 that the Total column nets: different basis, no amount missing. Separately, detail index 180 (Capital Projects Fund, p13, amount -12,430) is labelled 'Transfers In' although the amount is negative: removed and added back as 'Transfers Out' with the same amount.

gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Electric Fund, Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Trash Fund; no business-type lines in detail[]. JSON receipts = Consumer sales + Other revenue + Interest income. Electric 6,421,840 + 40,133 + 141,717 = 6,603,690; Water 883,511 + 3,933 = 887,444; Sewer 875,640 + 17,196 = 892,836; Trash 331,533. Sum 8,715,503 = statement total.
